newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH HESTIA INSURER TO PAY OUT TO FLOODED ZEW.
newsitem.headline: POLISH HESTIA INSURER TO PAY OUT TO FLOODED ZEW.

text.p: Poland's Hestia Insurance SA will make what may be the largest payment in its history to electrode maker ZEW SA which has been hit by floods, PAP news agency quoted a senior Hestia official as saying on Sunday.

"This will probably be the highest compensation payment in our six-year history," Hestia vice-president Witold Janusz was quoted as saying after visiting the Zaklady Elektrod Weglowych SA (ZEW) plant in the flood-damaged southern city Raciborz.

PAP said the ZEW factory had been insured for 230 million zlotys while preliminary estimates put its losses at 500 million. It added that Hestia considered that the plant had survived in better shape than expected.
The insurer will pay ZEW a first instalment next week for urgent repairs of the production hall and machinery, PAP said.
Meanwhile ZEW has reserves of stock which will allow it to remain on the market until production resumes. Some competitors including German firms have offered help it, PAP reported.
Trade in ZEW, which has 1,200 employees, was suspended indefinitely last week on the Warsaw bourse because of the flood.
Hestia Insurance SA is a subsidary of the German insurer Alte Leipziger Europa. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
